verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI can execute shell/git operations for tasks like 'handling complex rebases' and 'querying pull requests' (gh-4), and has GitHub Action integrations for PR reviews and issue triage (gh-10, gh-11, gh-12), suggesting some git/PR workflow support. However, there's no direct evidence of the agent autonomously staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, or opening PRs end-to-end, and community reports describe frequent failures in agentic tasks and codebase navigation (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-15).
